title: Countable products of pro-etale modules are exact
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme and $\mathcal R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on the small pro-etale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] (for instance a constant sheaf $A_Y$, or the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$). Countable products exist in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal R$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, are computed sectionwise, $(\prod_nF_n)(U)=\prod_nF_n(U)$, and are exact: if $F_n\to G_n$ is a surjection of sheaves of $\mathcal R$-modules for every $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, then $\prod_nF_n\to\prod_nG_n$ is surjective.

source.place: Proposition 3.1.9 (countable products are exact in a replete topos), Proposition 3.2.3(1) (a locally weakly contractible topos is replete), Proposition 4.2.8 ($\Shv(X_{\mathrm{proet}})$ is locally weakly contractible); for modules over $\mathcal R$, products and surjectivity are those of the underlying abelian sheaves

mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf categories have limits (`Sheaf.instHasLimits...`), so products exist; exactness of countable products (AB4*) for pro-etale sheaves is nowhere stated
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: existence of products is in Mathlib, exactness is not
